# 7stories

> AI cinematic storytelling studio — turn any moment, brand, or project into a cinematic story with an AI-generated cover image or film.

7stories lets you pick a category (wedding, newborn, baby, family, elders, books, pets, brand, product, events, travel, anniversary, memorial), add reference photos, choose your own AI language, image, and video models, and generate a story plus a cinematic image or film.

## Key facts
- Categories: wedding, newborn, baby, family, elders, books, pets, brand, product, events, travel, anniversary, memorial
- Output formats: Story, Book, Poem, Letter, Story video
- Image models: Flux Pro Ultra, Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash), Seedream 4.5, and more
- Video models: Veo 3, Kling, Seedance, MiniMax, Wan, LTX, Hunyuan, Mochi, Runway, Pika and more
- Language models: GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, o3-mini, GPT-4o mini
- Users can upload reference photos, enhance prompts with AI, and save stories to a cloud library.

## Pages
- Landing / studio: https://www.7stories.com/
- Templates: https://www.7stories.com/templates
- FAQ: https://www.7stories.com/faq
